info.title: Recipient Anticipation Settings (Preview)
info.description: Disabled by default; requires provider-connection enablement. This draft does not announce provider availability.

enabled.description: Whether anticipation is enabled. False is an explicit value.

type.description: Requested model. Availability depends on the enabled provider connection policy.

delay.description: Delay in days, from 1 through 365. Zero is rejected, including when enabled is false. FULL forbids this field; DAILY requires it for a complete configuration. 1025 defaults to 15 when omitted in a complete configuration.

volume_percentage.description: Required only for 1025_PERCENTAGE. Other models forbid this field.

AnticipationCreate.description: Null, duplicate and unknown fields are rejected. FULL forbids delay and volume_percentage, including when disabled. Model-specific requirements also apply.

enabled.description: Whether anticipation is enabled. False is an explicit value.

type.description: Requested model. Availability depends on the enabled provider connection policy.

delay.description: Delay in days, from 1 through 365. Zero is rejected, including when enabled is false. FULL forbids this field; DAILY requires it for a complete configuration. 1025 defaults to 15 when omitted in a complete configuration. A type change drops inherited delay, even when switching to the 1025_PERCENTAGE alias.

volume_percentage.description: Required only for 1025_PERCENTAGE. Other models forbid this field.

AnticipationPatch.description: Null, duplicate and unknown fields are rejected. FULL forbids delay and volume_percentage, including when disabled. Model-specific requirements also apply. Omitted fields merge only into confirmed settings. Without a confirmed base, send a complete configuration, including enabled and type. Any change to the type string drops inherited delay and volume_percentage, including 1025 to 1025_PERCENTAGE. Supply delay again to preserve it; 1025 and its alias otherwise default to 15.

enabled.description: Whether anticipation is enabled. False is an explicit value.

type.description: Confirmed canonical model, when available. The 100-percent alias is reported as 1025.

delay.description: Confirmed delay in days, when available. Zero is explicit.

requested_settings.description: Requested intent; it does not prove application.

enabled.description: Whether anticipation is enabled. False is an explicit value.

delay.description: Previous confirmed delay in days; not the current configuration.

historical_settings.description: Previous confirmation; it does not describe the current configuration.

AnticipationProjection.description: Top-level enabled/type/delay describe confirmed settings only when available. A disabled Pagar.me confirmation may contain enabled=false with no model fields. Read application_status and operation_status separately.

code.description: Read the code, not only the HTTP status, to choose a retry action. ANTICIPATION_PROVIDER_REJECTED is recorded and final for this key, even with 502 or 503. ONBOARDING_OPERATION_IN_PROGRESS (409) is unrecorded at admission but final for the key when recorded as REJECTED; check GET and use PATCH with a new key after a recorded rejection. REQUEST_CANNOT_BE_PROCESSED (400) means admission was temporarily unavailable and no provider request was sent; retry the same request later. INVALID_PARAMETERS (400) is also recorded when disabling without type while the provider still has anticipation enabled; send type with enabled=false using PATCH and a new key. The three upstream/edge failure codes leave the write outcome uncertain; retain the same key.

provider_http_status.description: Optional safe provider status; never a raw provider response.

post.description: Preview: requires explicit enablement for the provider connection. See the anticipation settings guide before use. Once admitted, the resource remains after rejection. A new attempt uses PATCH, a new key, and a complete configuration when no confirmed base exists.

parameters.name: recipient_id
parameters.description: Recipient owned by the authenticated account.

parameters.name: onboarding_id
parameters.description: Exactly one onboarding selector. Repeated parameters are rejected.

parameters.name: X-Account-Code
parameters.description: Authorized account containing the selected recipient.

parameters.name: X-Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: Nonblank key for this logical write. Repeat the same method, target and body with the same key after an uncertain response.

201.description: Settings applied or verified to match the requested configuration.

202.description: Application or execution remains uncertain. Read the settings with GET for the current state.

400.description: Invalid selector, account header, write key or settings (INVALID_PARAMETERS); recorded disable-without-type rejection (also INVALID_PARAMETERS); temporarily unavailable admission with no provider request sent (REQUEST_CANNOT_BE_PROCESSED); or recorded invalid-configuration rejection (ANTICIPATION_PROVIDER_REJECTED).

404.description: Recipient/onboarding is not accessible, or settings do not exist.

409.description: Read the error code: unsupported capability/model; existing resource (POST); idempotency conflict; changed/shared/ineligible target; unresolved/quarantined anticipation operation; or another onboarding operation holding the target (ONBOARDING_OPERATION_IN_PROGRESS). The onboarding-operation error is unrecorded at admission but final for the key if GET reports the operation REJECTED; use PATCH with a new key after that recorded rejection. A new key never bypasses a hold.

422.description: Recorded no-effect rejection, including typed provider rejection or a local timeout before mutation dispatch. Same-key replies are frozen.

502.description: Unusable upstream response or internal authentication failure; write outcome is uncertain. Retain the same key for a retry. Read the error code. ANTICIPATION_PROVIDER_REJECTED instead means a recorded no-effect rejection (for example unavailable preflight readback), final for this key.

503.description: ANTICIPATION_PROVIDER_REJECTED is a recorded no-effect rejection, final for this key. ANTICIPATION_SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE leaves the outcome uncertain; retry with the same key or GET. HTTP status alone does not determine retry behavior.

recorded_rejection.summary: Final for this key; resolve the cause, then PATCH with a new key

messages: The anticipation operation was not applied.

uncertain_result.summary: Keep the same key for retries; read GET for current state

messages: Unable to complete the anticipation settings request; retry with the same idempotency key or read the settings status.
